papers.title: Depth Sensing by Near-Infrared Light Absorption in Water
papers.input: 两个近红外波段的水下成像，另研究三波段变体。
papers.output: 水下物体的深度和形状。
papers.readingNote: 正式 TPAMI 43(8):2611–2622（2021）原始摘要与作者出版目录核验。与 ECCV 2016 Shape from Water 同团队同主题，原始摘要新增透视/发散光源及三波段稳健性描述；未经全文逐节比较，不称独立方法。摘要级收录，期刊正文/原图仍待取得，不能用会议图替代期刊框架。双/三波段属于相关研究，不是密集高光谱测量。

papers.title: Joint 3D shape and hyperspectral reconstruction from single-view spectro-polarimetric imaging
papers.input: 单视角光谱偏振观测及用于训练/评价的光谱–偏振–三维数据集。

papers.readingNote: 出版社原始摘要、八作者、DOI 与 OL 51(5):1132–1135 正式版本核验，2026-02-18 在线、3 月卷期。摘要级收录：具体网络、波段数量、误差指标与实验边界需正文进一步核验。与同团队 Nature Communications 2026 的 MOCI/PHI 传感器研究有关联，未经本文正文证明不判为其扩展版或独立平台；不借用该论文框架或实验数值。

papers.title: Real-time volumetric reconstruction of biological dynamics with light-field microscopy and deep learning
papers.input: 光场荧光视频与训练用三维图像；线虫实验同时记录绿色 GCaMP6 和红色 wCherry 通道。
papers.output: 逐颜色三维体序列及神经活动/生物动态；体深度轴是真实 z。
papers.readingNote: 核验作者实验室 15 页原始稿及出版社 DOI/12 作者，Nature Methods 18:551–556，2021-02-11 在线。正文线虫部分明确一分种绿色/红色光场记录和比率校正：双颜色属于相关阅读，不能写成连续高光谱体成像。100 Hz 采集与约 13.5 Hz 该实验重建吞吐不同；200 Hz 是另一个生物采集场景，不写成全部通道实时重建速度。Figure 1a,b 为采集/训练/推理流程，c–j 为结果，不用结果冒充框架。

metadata.abstract: <jats:p>Shape from Polarization (SfP) has emerged as a promising technique for reconstructing the three-dimensional (3D) structure of objects using polarization information. However, existing 3D reconstruction methods generally suffer from degraded accuracy when dealing with dark or low-reflectivity surfaces, resulting in unreliable point cloud data. Furthermore, most current methods generally focus on geometric reconstruction, such as surface normals or depth maps, limiting their ability to capture the spectral characteristics of objects’ materials. Here, we propose a novel single-view spectro-polarimetric imaging (SVSPI) method that, for the first time to our knowledge, achieves joint reconstruction of 3D shape and hyperspectral information from single-view spectro-polarimetric imaging for dark-surfaced objects. This method uses an on-chip broadband hyperspectral imaging sensor and introduces a dedicated spectral-polarization-3D dataset to support training and evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving the simultaneous reconstruction of surface normals, depth maps, and spectral information within the 400–1000 nm range under complex environmental conditions.</jats:p>
title: Joint 3D shape and hyperspectral reconstruction from single-view spectro-polarimetric imaging
